_status: DESIGN APPROVED 2026-11-24 (entity + 2 choice sets, SourceRun shows RunId, DataService package OK).
purpose: Lets the receipt, invoice and payment tests run independently and in parallel without receiving or invoicing the same PO schedule. A test set reserves one PO schedule, works on it, then marks it Consumed (or Released on failure). Expired reservations can be reclaimed.

choiceSets.name: OracleP2PReservationStatus
choiceSets.description: Lifecycle of a PO schedule reservation

choiceSets.name: OracleP2PReservationPurpose
choiceSets.description: Which downstream test the PO schedule is reserved for

entity.name: OracleP2PReservation
entity.description: One row per reserved PO schedule. ReservationKey <PO>|<Line>|<Schedule>|<Purpose> is unique, so one schedule can be held by one test per purpose at a time.

fields.name: ReservedBy
fields.description: Test Manager test set key, e.g. OFP2P:300

fields.name: RunId
fields.description: RunId of the test run holding the reservation

fields.name: SourceRun
fields.description: The OracleP2PRun record that created the PO

fields.name: ExpiresAt
fields.description: After this a reservation may be reclaimed (Expired)

arguments.in_RunId: String - the caller's RunId (written when it claims a fallback)
arguments.out_Snapshot: Dictionary(String, String) - supplier, site, item, quantities, unit price, amount, currency

logic: 1. Query OracleP2PReservation where ReservedBy = in_TestSetKey and Purpose = in_Purpose and Status = Reserved and ExpiresAt > now; take the newest. If found: set Status = InUse, return its PO and snapshot (Source = Reservation).

2. Else fall back to the latest OracleP2PRun whose TestMarker starts with UIP-TEST- at the right Stage (Receipt -> PO, Invoice -> Received, Payment -> Validated), sorted by LastStageAt desc, that has no active reservation for this purpose. Insert a Reserved/InUse reservation for it (unique key prevents two tests taking the same schedule), return its PO and snapshot (Source = RunRecord).
3. Else return Source = None (caller fails the test with a clear message).
workflow.needs: UiPath.DataService.Activities package and the three entities imported into the project (Data Service) - will ask before installing
